images.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: CAPRA COOL summer collection website campaign photograph, wide landscape 1536x1024. Create an understated fashion editorial still life: ivory and washed-black heavyweight cotton crew-neck T-shirts hanging neatly from two wooden hangers on a simple rail beside a sunlit pale limestone wall, a small glimpse of soft green Himalayan foothills at the far edge. Small restrained dark mountain chest embroidery, no words. Cotton weave and natural folds must look realistic. Warm summer daylight, soft shadows, refined cream/stone/black palette. Compose garments centrally with generous margins so a portrait crop also works. Photograph only, no typography, no banners, no watermark, no collage, no invented brand names, no people. Match a quiet contemporary Himalayan streetwear storefront.
